title: Sculpted spherical afro on older man
caption: A fictional dark-skinned African man in his late 60s wearing a large, dense Afro shaped into a controlled near-spherical silhouette.
patternDescription: Generated with a dense Type 4C-like coily texture whose tight pattern supports substantial picked-out volume; the image should not be treated as evidence of a real person's natural subtype.
lengthDescription: Substantial coily length expanded outward from the scalp, creating a broad rounded silhouette with balanced volume through the crown, sides and lower perimeter.
